<!--- Fonts --->

\providecommand{\B}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\providecommand{\mrm}[1]{\mathrm{#1}}

<!--- Sets --->

\providecommand{\NN}{\mathbb{N}}
\providecommand{\RR}{\mathbb{R}}
\providecommand{\Rp}{\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}}
\providecommand{\CC}{\mathbb{C}}

<!--- Special Characters --->

\providecommand{\ii}{\mathrm{i}}
\providecommand{\eps}{\varepsilon}

<!--- Functions --->

\providecommand{\Sin}[1]{\sin \left( #1 \right)}
\providecommand{\Cos}[1]{\cos \left( #1 \right)}
\providecommand{\ex}[1]{\mathrm{e}^{#1}}

<!--- Linear Algebra --->

\providecommand{\II}{\mathcal{I}}

\providecommand{\Mat}[1]{\begin{pmatrix} #1 \end{pmatrix}}
\providecommand{\BMat}[1]{\begin{bmatrix} #1 \end{bmatrix}}
\providecommand{\mat}[1]{\begin{matrix} #1 \end{matrix}}

\providecommand{\Tr}[1]{{#1}^{\mathrm{T}}}
\providecommand{\He}[1]{{#1}^{\mathrm{H}}}

<!--- Spacing --->

\providecommand{\qiq}{\quad \implies \quad}
\providecommand{\iq}{\implies \quad}
\providecommand{\qtq}[1]{\quad \text{#1} \quad}
\providecommand{\tq}[1]{\text{#1} \quad}
\providecommand{\qt}[1]{\quad \text{#1}}

<!--- Arrows --->

\providecommand{\mathimplies}[1]{\quad \xrightarrow[#1]{} \quad}
\providecommand{\textimplies}[1]{\quad \xrightarrow[\mathrm{#1}]{} \quad}

<!--- Brackets --->

\providecommand{\nbr}[1]{\left( #1 \right)}
\providecommand{\sbr}[1]{\left[ #1 \right]}
\providecommand{\cbr}[1]{\left\{ #1 \right\}}
\providecommand{\abr}[1]{\langle #1 \rangle}
\providecommand{\abs}[1]{\left| #1 \right|}
\providecommand{\norm}[1]{\left\| #1 \right\|}
\providecommand{\Norm}[2]{\left\| #1 \right\|_{#2}}

<!--- Calculus --->

\providecommand{\odiff}[2]{\frac{\mathrm{d} #1}{\mathrm{d} #2}}
\providecommand{\Odiff}[3]{\frac{\mathrm{d}^{#3} #1}{\mathrm{d} #2^{#3}}}
\providecommand{\bodiff}[2]{\frac{\mathrm{d} \boldsymbol{#1}}{\mathrm{d} #2}}

\providecommand{\pdiff}[2]{\frac{\partial #1}{\partial #2}}
\providecommand{\Pdiff}[3]{\frac{\partial^{#3} #1}{\partial #2^{#3}}}
\providecommand{\bpdiff}[2]{\frac{\partial \boldsymbol{#1}}{\partial #2}}

\providecommand{\Integ}[2]{\int \! #1 \; \mathrm{d} #2}
\providecommand{\integ}[4]{\int\limits_{#1}^{#2} \! #3 \; \mathrm{d} #4}

<!--- Misc --->

\providecommand{\OO}[1]{\mathcal{O}\left(#1\right)}
\providecommand{\nth}[1]{{#1}^{\mathrm{th}}}
\providecommand{\E}[1]{\times 10^{#1}}
\providecommand{\degC}{^{\circ} \mathrm{C}}
